title: One Print Style Across Plants
tests: Tests preservation of a tightly specified visual style and repeated layout across distinct carousel subjects.

faults.what: All four plants are rendered photographically rather than in the requested sage-green-and-cream linocut style; the requested border and printed paper texture are absent.
The pot shape is not held consistent: Pothos has a visible cream tapered pot, while the other slides show only a dark base or narrow soil opening without a matching pot body.
The repeated template changes visibly: name size, weight and vertical position vary, particularly the smaller, lighter Pothos label, and the plant/base placement shifts between slides.

judge.summary: Four correctly named, recognizable plants appear on separate square slides, but the requested linocut treatment and locked border, pot and layout template are not delivered.

must_haves.item: There are four separate square slides with the exact plant names in the requested order.
must_haves.why: The four square images read Monstera, Snake plant, Pothos and Peace lily in that order.

must_haves.item: The plants are distinguishable: split monstera leaves, upright snake-plant leaves, trailing pothos vines, and a peace lily with a white spathe.
must_haves.why: All four identifying features are clearly visible, including trailing pothos vines and white peace-lily spathes.

must_haves.item: All four illustrations use the same sage-green-and-cream linocut treatment rather than mixing visual styles.
must_haves.why: The images use naturalistic photographic plant rendering, not a limited-palette linocut treatment.

must_haves.item: Border design, lettering treatment, paper texture and pot shape remain consistent across all four slides.
must_haves.why: No designed border or linocut paper texture is visible, lettering size and weight vary, and only the Pothos slide has a clearly visible full cream pot.

must_haves.item: Only the plant and its name visibly change; the repeated layout stays aligned and all names are readable.
must_haves.why: Every name is readable, but text baselines, type scale, plant placement and pot presentation change across slides.
